title: Homotopy coherent Gysin functoriality
summary: We construct homotopy coherent Gysin pullbacks for weak Borel-Moore theories on smooth schemes, addressing the higher coherence problem for Gysin morphisms associated with closed immersions and lci-type factorizations. The construction uses the higher deformation spaces of Dubouloz-Mayeux attached to flags of closed immersions, from which we build higher Gysin simplices and their simplicial identities up to contractible choices. A rigidification procedure then turns this coherent system into a strict contravariant simplicial functor extending both smooth pullbacks and closed-immersion Gysin…
